input.text: The Agency's mandate is amended as follows: 'Article 5 shall apply.' Article 7 remains unaffected.

_note: The possessive apostrophe in "Agency's" must NOT be read as an opening straight single quote mark by the quote-span detector. 'Article 5' (genuinely inside the quoted amending text) must be detected as inside it and rerouted EXTERNAL; 'Article 7' (genuinely outside, after the quote closes) must stay INTERNAL either way.
